# Yalp — full product summary for LLMs

## What it is

Yalp is a productivity web application for managing todos and lists, with MCP integration so clients such as Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Web, Windsurf, and VS Code can connect to your account via a hosted MCP server and API keys.

## Core features

- Inbox / “All” view for tasks not assigned to a list
- Custom lists with stable URL slugs per user
- Today view for due/today-focused work
- MCP Connections page: generate API keys, copy JSON config, one-click Cursor install where supported
- Subscriptions via Stripe (monthly, yearly, lifetime Pro)

## Free vs Pro (limits)

Free tier (aligned with app constants):

- Up to 25 active todos in the inbox / All list combined
- 1 extra list beyond the default
- Up to 10 active todos per extra list

Pro removes these caps (unlimited active todos and lists).

## URLs (public vs app)

Public marketing and auth: `/`, `/login`, `/signup`. Authenticated app routes under `/all`, `/today`, `/integrations`, `/mcp`, list slugs, and `/subscription/*` require sign-in and are not intended for search indexing.

## Official links

Canonical production host: `https://yalp.ai` (set `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` to match the URL users open, e.g. your Vercel URL, until DNS is configured).

- Home: /
- Login: /login
- Sign up: /signup
